استنصرت (form X)
# اِسْتَنْصَرْتُ (istanṣartu) /is.tan.sˤar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
# اِسْتَنْصَرْتَ (istanṣarta) /is.tan.sˤar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
# اِسْتَنْصَرْتِ (istanṣarti) /is.tan.sˤar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
# اِسْتَنْصَرَتْ (istanṣarat) /i
